summary: Tested the WhatsApp Cloud 'Conectar con WhatsApp' feature while Meta is unconfigured. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. Covers owner status (enabled=false, connection=null, 8 NOT_CREATED templates), connect returning 503, sync/disconnect returning 409, and 403 for receptionist/manager/stylist on all 4 wa-cloud endpoints. Super admin companies list includes the wa_cloud field with no WA token. Webhook cases all return ok: empty entry, template status for an unknown WABA, status for an unknown wamid, and messages for an unknown phone_number_id. A template status for a known WABA updates the templates. Simulator inbound sets delivery=simulated. Portal booking confirmation sets delivery=simulated. A fake wa_connection still delivers simulated, and admin then shows connected=true. Frontend: owner sees tab-whatsapp, a disabled 'Pendiente de configuración' button and 8 template rows marked 'Se crea al conectar'. ?tab=whatsapp deep link works. Receptionist, manager and stylist see no tab. Super admin Empresas table has a WhatsApp column and company-wa-bellavida shows 'Simulador'.

minor.issue: Pre-existing, not WA: company.card object (incl. card.token e.g. 'tok_sim_demo') is returned to super admin. Simulated today, but should be stripped before real card tokenization.
Malformed (non-JSON) body raises json error -> 500. Meta always sends JSON, so low risk; wrap json.loads in try and return 400.

update_one({'wa_id': s.get('id')}) with missing id would match {'wa_id': None} = any doc without wa_id (all simulated outgoing). Guard: skip when id falsy. Also out-of-order statuses (read then delivered) can downgrade delivery.
Returns 200 when connection already disconnected (only checks doc existence, not status=connected). Spec-ok but inconsistent with sync's 409.

issues: Disabled pending button (white text on 50%-opacity green) has low contrast; acceptable for disabled state but consider a muted gray style

action_items: Optional: guard on_status against empty status id
critical_code_review_comments: wa_send inserts then updates delivery. If deliver() raises unexpectedly, the message stays without a delivery field. deliver already catches graph errors, so this is acceptable.
list_companies runs statement() per company (N+1). This is fine at current scale.
Real Meta flow (connect/create_templates/sync/deliver sent path) is untested because no credentials are available.
